buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ​1. Load Test, Inspection and Certification of Mobile Floor Crane A. Mandatory Load Test: The offered Mobile Floor Crane shall be subjected to an actual physic al load test at 125% of the Safe Working Load (SWL), i.e., 3,750 kg for a crane having an SWL o f 3,000 kg, subject to the applicable test procedure and the manufacturer's approved test para meters. The test shall verify the structural integrity, lifting mechanism, hydraulic system, stabil ity and safe functioning of the crane under the specified test conditions. B. Independent Testing and Certification: The load test shall be conducted and certified by an independent competent person or testing agency duly recognized /approved by the relevan t statutory authority, wherever such recognition is prescribed under applicable law. The testing and certification shall be independent of the manufacturer/supplier. A certificate issued solely

by the manufacturer, supplier or their own personnel, without independent witnessing and verification of the actual physical load test, shall not be accepted. C. Evidence of Actual Testing: The supplier shall submit the original or verifiable test certificat e and detailed test report containing, at a minimum: a. Make, model, serial number and identification details of the crane; b. Rated SWL and the actual test load applied; c. Date and location of the physical load test; d. Test procedure and relevant applicable standard/statutory requirements; e. Details and traceability of the test weights or calibrated load-measuring equipment used; f. Observations and results of the test, including any deformation, leakage, instability or mal function; D. Verification by AIASL: AIASL reserves the right to witness the load test, verify the credential s of the testing agency/competent person, cross-verify the certificate directly with its issuer an d require re-testing, at the supplier's cost, where the submitted documents or test results are f ound unsatisfactory or unverifiable. E. Acceptance and Payment: Submission of the requisite test certificate and report, and their acceptance by AIASL, shall be mandatory for acceptance of the crane. Any certificate found to be forged, fabricated, misleading or unsupported by an actual test shall render the supply liabl e to rejection and may attract action under the applicable tender conditions and law. Non-Compliance of above shall result in rejection of the Bid. 2. To comply with Experience Criteria of One Year Mentioned in Bid Document, Bidder shall submit GeM C ontract along with CRAC/SDAC and Invoice . For out of GeM supplies, Work Order/Order document along wi th Invoice and proof for acceptance of supply of mobile Floor Crane/Crane with same or higher configurati on( i.e. Lifting capacity of 3 Ton or above) by the Bidder or the OEM to any Central /State Govt Office/Department or PSU /CPSE/Airport Operator /Airlines /Ground Handling Agency or any Private compan y or Firm including partnership Firm during any of the Following Financial Year A. FY 2023-24 B. FY 2024-25 C. FY 2025-26 Supply made during FY 2026-27 shall also be considered. Non-Compliance of above shall result in rejection of the Bid. 3. Pre- Delivery Inspection: AI ASL reserves the right to carry out Pre-Delivery Inspection of Mobile Floor Crane prior to dispatch, any deviation or non -compliance observed need to be rectified within 03 Da ys or the time limit approved by AIASL and delay beyond the time limit approved by AIASL shall result in i mposing of Penalty as per Penalty clause. Expenses involved in To and Fro Transportation( Hiring of Car ) of AIASL Officials from Airport /Railway stati on/Bus Stand /AIASL office to Bidder or OEM manufacturing facility shall be borne by the Bidder. Non-Compliance of above shall result in rejection of the Bid. 4. Penalty Clause: In case of delayed delivery, a penalty of 0.5% per week or part thereof of the contract value shall be imposed, subject to a maximum of 10% of the contract value, after due notification. If AIASL observes that the delay is affecting or is likely to affect operations, AIASL reserves the right to cancel the L OA/PO, and the bidder may be blacklisted for a minimum period of six months, as specified in the RFQ. Non-Compliance of above shall result in rejection of the Bid. 5. Delivery Period: Bidder shall deliver the Mobile Floor Crane within 15 Days of issuance of GeM Contra ct.

Non-Compliance of above shall result in rejection of the Bid. 6. Warranty: Bidder shall provide warranty of min 02 Years covering all defects including manufacturing defect. Non-Compliance of above shall result in rejection of the Bid. 7. Eligibility for Availing MSME Benefits: MSE benefits will be applicable as per MSE Policy in effe ct at present. Non-Compliance of above shall result in rejection of the Bid. 8. Eligibility for Availing Start-up Benefits: Benefits admissible to eligible Start-ups under applicable Government of India policies, including exemptio n from EMD and relaxation in prior Turnover (wherever specifically permitted under this Bid), shall be avail able only to bidders recognized as Start-ups by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trad e (DPIIT) and holding a valid and subsisting Start-up Recognition Certificate as on the Bid due date. Such Start-up recognition must cover business activities/category directly relevant and similar to the subje ct matter of this Bid. For this tender, the eligible activities/category shall include hiring, leasing, rental, flee t operations, transport services, or similar services relating to passenger vehicles. The bidder shall further ensure and certify that its turnover in any financial year has not exceeded the limit s prescribed under the applicable DPIIT Start-up recognition norms / certificate / Start-up scheme, and that it continues to remain eligible as a Start-up on the Bid due date. Bidders recognized as Start-ups only for unrelated activities / categories, or those functioning merely as Tr aders, dealers, resellers, commission agents, intermediaries, or aggregators without relevant operational c apability, or those exceeding the prescribed eligibility limits, shall not be eligible to claim Start-up benefits under this tender. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence in support of Start-up recognition, relevant business activit y/category, and continued eligibility status. The decision of AIASL regarding eligibility , relevance of activit y/category, and admissibility of benefits shall be final and binding. 9. Bidder shall submit ATC Document on its Letter Head filled with information and supportive documents as requested in ATC document. Non-Compliance of above shall result in rejection of the Bid. 10. Performance Security: Bidder shall submit performance security i.e 3 % of Contract value for a peri od of 26 months. Non-Compliance of above shall result in rejection of the Bid 11. Bidder shall submit undertaking for acceptance of Bid Terms and Conditions including Buyer added ATC Clauses. Non-Compliance of above shall result in rejection of the Bid. . 3. On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name AI Airport Services Limited Account No. 00600310003602 IFSC Code HDFC0000060

Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract.
